name: Olaparib (mCRPC with HRR/BRCA mutation)

biomarkers.HRR: deleterious or suspected-deleterious germline or somatic homologous-recombination-repair (HRR) gene mutation required
biomarkers.BRCA: category 1 recommendation for BRCA-mutated (BRCA1/BRCA2) disease; preferred if docetaxel not yet received
biomarkers.note: Olaparib is a PARP inhibitor active in HRR-mutated disease via synthetic lethality; it is not effective without an HRR mutation. HRR genes considered for olaparib per the source: BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, BARD1, BRIP1, CDK12, CHEK1, CHEK2, FANCL, PALB2, RAD51B, RAD51C, RAD51D, RAD54L. Somatic tumor and germline assays (or plasma ctDNA if biopsy not feasible) identify eligible patients. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Prostate Cancer, Discussion (Olaparib, PROfound).

lineOfTherapy: molecular-biomarker-directed PARP inhibitor for mCRPC with an HRR mutation after prior ARPI, regardless of prior docetaxel; category 1 and preferred for BRCA-mutated disease not yet treated with docetaxel

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: deleterious or suspected-deleterious germline or somatic HRR gene mutation (e.g., BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, BARD1, BRIP1, CDK12, CHEK1, CHEK2, FANCL, PALB2, RAD51B, RAD51C, RAD51D, RAD54L)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, Discussion (Olaparib/PROfound), prostate lines 7657 to 7662 (HRR genes considered; category 1 for BRCAm mCRPC)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: prior ARPI (abiraterone or enzalutamide); permitted before or after docetaxel
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, Discussion, prostate lines 7658 to 7660 (olaparib option for mCRPC with previous ARPI and an HRRm regardless of prior docetaxel)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: ongoing ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL

drugs.name: Olaparib

provenance.locator: Discussion, prostate line 7611 (PROfound: olaparib 300 mg twice daily); prostate line 7657 (FDA approved olaparib 300 mg twice daily, May 2020)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion, prostate lines 7611 and 7657. Olaparib 300 mg PO TWICE daily (two 150 mg tablets twice daily) continuously (represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle). Requires an HRR/BRCA mutation (biomarker gate).

supportiveCare: biomarker gate: confirm an HRR (including BRCA1/BRCA2) mutation by a validated germline/somatic assay, or plasma ctDNA if a metastatic biopsy is not feasible, before starting (Discussion, prostate line ~7663).
continue ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL (PROS-G).
cycles null: continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
monitor complete blood counts and hepatic/renal function; transfusion support and dose reductions may be needed for anemia (Discussion, prostate line ~7665).

monitoring: CBC monthly (anemia, thrombocytopenia; rare risk of MDS/AML)
PSA and serum testosterone (confirm castrate level)
thromboembolic events and pneumonitis (rare but serious)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 or higher anemia or other hematologic toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Hold olaparib per labeling; transfuse as needed; resume at a reduced dose after recovery; obtain clinical review. Discontinue if MDS/AML is confirmed.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: PARP inhibition (olaparib) exploits synthetic lethality in HRR/BRCA-mutated prostate cancer; PROfound improved outcomes versus abiraterone/enzalutamide

guideline.locator: Discussion (Olaparib/PROfound): olaparib 300 mg twice daily (prostate lines 7611, 7657); HRR gene list and category 1 for BRCAm, preferred if docetaxel not yet received (prostate lines 7657 to 7662); prior ARPI required, regardless of prior docetaxel (prostate lines 7658 to 7660); PROS-18 Molecular Biomarker-Directed Therapy (BRCA mutation), prostate line 1783

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for olaparib in HRR/BRCA-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (disease #54 mCRPC; PROfound). The olaparib dose (300 mg PO twice daily) is dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion (prostate lines 7611 and 7657). Biomarker gate: a deleterious or suspected-deleterious germline or somatic HRR mutation (BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, BARD1, BRIP1, CDK12, CHEK1, CHEK2, FANCL, PALB2, RAD51B, RAD51C, RAD51D, RAD54L) is required, with category 1 status for BRCA-mutated disease; prior ARPI is required regardless of prior docetaxel. cycleLengthDays 28 with cycles null (continuous until progression). Ongoing ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL is required. No dose was invented or inferred. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
